scope: Exploratory full-record patient-mean biomarker correlations within native diagnosis-code groups. Not baseline adjustment, pre-event prediction, causal effects, cancer-stage adjudication, or OMOP alignment. Original cohort members and original outcome labels remain unchanged.
sources: Previously hash-verified raw-source diagnostic staging only; diagnosis_code remains the native source code, not a mapped concept. All accepted current/discharge source records associated with each original patient are eligible. No diagnostic text is used to construct cancer groups.
exclude: Exclude source_value_conflict=true, unlinked source persons, pathology morphology codes, history/admission/outpatient roles. Count exclusions and missing codes explicitly.
normalization: Unicode NFKC, surrounding whitespace removal, uppercase. Require full-string match C[0-9]{2}(.[A-Z0-9]+)? with a literal dot. A three-character category must occur in the explicit valid dictionary. National suffixes are not clinically validated; only the three-character category is used.
dictionary_version: ICD-10-WHO Version 2019, official BfArM publication; category-level dictionary only, not German Modification
priority: C97 or more than one broad primary group => multiple_broad_groups_or_C97. Exactly one broad primary group => that group, regardless of additional C76-C80. No primary group and C76-C80 => secondary_or_unspecified_only. Otherwise retain explicit unknown/source-unavailable groups. Multiple broad groups describe recorded codes, not adjudicated multiple primaries. Secondary sites are never used to assign a primary site. No code is not evidence of no cancer.

biomarkers.NSE: 神经元特异性烯醇化酶

estimand: Spearman correlation of observed original full-record patient means, pairwise complete without zero imputation. Same patient can contribute different pairs. No age/sex, stage, treatment or acute-severity adjustment is claimed.
reporting: Each original full cohort plus every prespecified mutually exclusive stratum. Report stratum n, pairwise-complete n and missing n even when not estimated. Estimate only when pair n>=50 and both variables nonconstant. No selection by direction, magnitude or statistical significance; no primary p-value testing.

bootstrap.seed_rule: seed_base + 1000*cohort_index + 10*stratum_index + pair_index; cohort SCH=0,WHU=1; full cohort stratum=0, followed by strata_order
bootstrap.method: Patient resampling with replacement of each complete-pair set, recompute Spearman ranks on each resample; percentile 95% interval; undefined constant resamples counted and excluded from interval calculation.

limitations: Cancer codes are full-record descriptive source categories and may be later than biomarker measurements or the cardiovascular diagnostic label.
Current-source diagnostic linkage does not establish that every historical cancer source record was captured.
Code dictionaries/local extensions and original laboratory units were not re-harmonized between centers.
Stage/treatment/drug/acuity fields exist in raw sources, but no audited baseline exposure extraction contract is established. Their effects remain unadjusted.
Associations do not establish an inflammatory causal pathway or resolve reverse causation, treatment effects, case-mix, stage, or selective measurement.
